verdict.rationale: Building custom AI agents is a fair question for a work-management SaaS, so the axis applies, but nothing in the evidence shows an in-product agent builder. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit: AI writing help, rule-based automation, Power-Up developer tooling, and an MCP server that lets external AI tools connect to Trello.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build and configure my own custom AI agent within the product
